Chapter 224: Chapter 16 Identity Revelation (Subscription Request)_3

Chapter 224: Chapter 16 Identity Revelation (Subscription Request)_3

The eldest senior brother said solemnly.

A Sixth Rank Evolver’s Life Essence is strong enough to leave a mark in the universe.

This kind of mark is also known as a Life Brand, and as long as the Brand exists, even if Lin Yuan falls, the Supreme Beings of the Human Race can use this bit of Life Brand as an ‘Anchor Point’ to reverse time for resurrection.

As for those below the Sixth Rank, their Life Essence isn’t strong enough; if they die, they truly die, and nobody can bring them back.

“Understood.”

Lin Yuan nodded.

...

Branding one’s Life Brand into the universe is something all Evolvers do as soon as they step into the Sixth Rank.

It relates to whether one can be resurrected in the future, and even those Sixth Rank Evolvers without the privilege of resurrection will do the same.

Who knows, in some future era, their offspring might make great achievements and beseech a Supreme Being to resurrect them?

…

Chenxi Mainstar.

The Chikun Star Domain has eight major star systems, with over a million Life Planets.

Among them, the Dawn Star System is not the weakest of the eight major star systems, but it’s also not associated with the strongest, ranking around fifth or sixth all year round.

Chenxi Mainstar, within a certain department.

This department is one of the core departments of Chenxi Mainstar, responsible for connecting with Chikun Main Star, and constantly relaying the many orders sent from Chikun Main Star.

“Ah, who knows when Peak Master Shisan will step into the Sixth Rank, or what Peak Master Shisan’s real identity is… Could it be from our Dawn Star System?”

Within the department, a female employee chatted idly with a colleague.

In the Virtual World’s arena area, Peak Master Shisan’s last few battles, especially the way he shattered the Wanyang Holy Son with two slaps, convinced many powerful beings in the outside world that Peak Master Shisan’s soul had achieved 100% compatibility.

Stepping into the Sixth Rank as a result is also a recent event.

Once someone becomes a Sixth Rank, the importance of keeping Peak Master Shisan’s identity secret vanishes, and it can be made public.

And according to the style of Chikun Main Star, from which star system Peak Master Shisan hails, that system’s main star will be responsible for dissemination.

If Peak Master Shisan is not from the eight major star systems, then Chikun Main Star will personally make it public.

“I think the possibility of Peak Master Shisan being from the Dawn Star System is not big; in my Dawn Star System, there are only over a hundred High-grade Life Planets, while other powerful star systems have hundreds of High-grade Life Planets to start with.”

“Geniuses like Peak Master Shisan are likely to be born on High-grade Life Planets.”

Another department employee spoke up.

The many differences between High-grade Life Planets and Middle and Low-grade Life Planets include the probability of giving birth to geniuses.

The former is much higher than the latter.

High-grade Life Planets, accommodating higher quality cosmic energy, living long-term under such quality of cosmic energy means that even a mediocre talent can match geniuses from Middle-grade Life Planets.

“Any news from the other star systems?”

The third department employee asked.

If Peak Master Shisan were from another star system, Chikun Main Star would definitely inform that system, and the news would be publicized immediately.

“Not yet.”

“I’m keeping an eye on it.”

The first woman who spoke up said.

“It’s been so long; Peak Master Shisan should have made a breakthrough by now. Anything that should be made public would be, unless Peak Master Shisan really hails from outside the Chikun Star Domain, and was picked up by a Star Lord during their travels in the universe?”

A department employee wondered.

While they were chatting.

Beep beep beep beep beep—

The entire department suddenly lit up with a red light.

“A document has been received from Chikun Main Star.”

“Peak Master Shisan’s true identity, comes from the Dawn Star System…”
